facts.title: Broccoli Pesto Pasta with Green Olives
ingredients: 1 pound uncooked pasta, such as rigatoni or penne
1 cup plain green olives, drained and pitted
2 cups fresh basil leaves (about 1 ⅓ ounce, or 2 small containers)
Several twists of freshly ground black pepper, to taste
Optional, for serving: Dollops of ricotta and/or red pepper flakes, drizzle of olive oil
facts.author: Cookie and Kate
